items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Try walking after dinner to see how it affects you. Across the program, a walk after dinner went with a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones in the same person. Try to start dinner before 8 pm, as sugar also rose 13.3 mg/dL more after a dinner at 8-9 pm than after one before 6 pm.
